messages:
People Ops: Quick heads-up — Lina's birthday is next Friday. Thinking about a hybrid thing: office cake + Zoom confetti or keep it virtual with an e-card and e-gift? :tada:
Amy: Ooh either works. If office cake, I can bring something small (SF office).
Noah: Remote from Berlin — prefer virtual card + Zoom confetti so APAC/EMEA folks can join.
Birthday Bot: 🎉 Reminder: Lina's birthday in 7 days. Add to calendar? /add-bday Lina 2026-04-01
People Ops: Poll options — react with :one: :two: :three:
1) Office cake at 3pm PT + Zoom link
2) Virtual e-card + e-gift (no in-person food)
3) Both: small nut-free cake + e-card
Jules: :one: — I can bring napkins and paper plates.
Sam: :two: — I can handle collecting for the gift (suggest $10 each). I’ll post a collection link.
Amy: @Sam count me in for $10. Also any dietary restrictions we should know about?
Lina: Aww thanks everyone! I'm allergic to nuts, so please no nuts in the cake. ❤️
Noah: Also timezone note — 3pm PT = 11pm for me, but I can join for a quick confetti moment. I volunteer to be GIF spammer on Zoom. :grin:
People Ops: Noted — nut-free only if we do cake. If :one: or :three: wins I’ll order from Bakery Co (they do vegan and nut-free).
Sam: For the virtual card idea — can we have a short Slack thread where people drop messages/gifs? I’ll pin it and compile into a card.
People Ops: Yes, we'll open a dedicated card thread in #random the morning of. For now, vote via reactions. Final decision tomorrow 2pm PT. :calendar:
Amy: RSVP: in-person 3pm PT — bringing a small chocolate (nut-free) cake.
Jules: RSVP: in-person, will help with cleanup. :sparkles:
Noah: RSVP: Zoom-only, will show up for the confetti moment.
Sam: I’ll post the collection link shortly and set a $10 suggestion.
People Ops: Thanks! If anyone wants to volunteer to host the Zoom (share camera + sing?), drop a note. Otherwise I’ll create the meeting and add link when we confirm. :thumbsup:
